findings.F1: Sense 3 (make someone bored or uninterested) is labeled formal; it is informal.
findings.F2: The pronoun-position learner error has incorrect and correct swapped, contradicting its own note.
findings.F3: The adaptation false_friends note restates the 'close the light' learner error (one fact, two fields).
findings.F4: The sense 1 definition is causative only, yet the grammar and an example show an intransitive use.
findings.F5: switch-on-phrv, an antonym, is listed among the sense 1 synonyms.
findings.F6: The adaptation pronunciation note repeats the turnoff stress contrast in pronunciation.notes.
findings.F7: disable-v is not a true synonym of turn off for lights, machines, or water.
